Champions national sovereignty, fiscal discipline, and common-sense accountability for Trump.
talking_points: The corporate media pollsters pushing narratives on Trump are the same 'experts' who underestimated the MAGA movement every single cycle—working-class patriots care about secure borders, cheap gas, and safe streets.
Everyday Americans reading about Trump vote with their wallets: stop Washington's reckless inflation spending, put American workers first, and let the voters decide at the ballot box.
